description: Luxury design apartment just 800 m from Reykjavik city centre. By the sea, cafés and restaurants, all within easy walking distance. Bright new 1-bed with king-size bed and large wardrobe, fully equipped kitchen with coffee machine, fridge/freezer, washer, oven and cooktop. Living room with sofa bed, dining table, TV and access to the balcony. Lift access to the apartment.
